hero.subtitle: A student-built FIRST Tech Challenge team engineering for the moment the game changes speed. We design, iterate, and drive — not for a single fast lap, but for control at every velocity.

about.heading: Built for the turns, not just the straightaway.
about.paragraph1: Variable Velocity is FIRST Tech Challenge Team 36397 — a student-run team that treats every match like a system with changing conditions. We design robots that hold precision whether they’re moving fast, slow, or somewhere in between.
about.paragraph2: Our process is iterative and CAD-first: prototype, test on the field, measure what actually happened, and redesign. We value the data as much as the result, and we document our reasoning so the next build season starts smarter than the last.
about.paragraph3: Off the field, we bring that same engineering mindset to our community — running workshops, mentoring younger teams, and making STEM feel approachable to students who haven’t found their way into it yet.

values.heading: What drives the build.
values.subheading: Three principles steer every design decision, every mentorship session, and every match strategy we run.

items.title: Control Over Chaos
items.description: Speed means nothing without control. We engineer for consistency across every condition the game throws at us.

items.title: Test, Measure, Rebuild
items.description: Every prototype is a hypothesis. We track what fails as carefully as what works, and we’re not precious about starting over.

items.title: Open the Track
items.description: We mentor newer teams and run outreach because the fastest way to grow the sport is to bring more people onto the field.

robot.heading: Built for precision at every speed.
robot.subheading: Our robot is designed around a CAD-first, iterative process — every mechanism is prototyped, field-tested, and refined before it earns a permanent spot on the chassis.

features.title: Mecanum Drive
features.description: Four-wheel mecanum drivetrain for omnidirectional movement and precise alignment on the field.

features.title: REV Control Hub
features.description: Centralized control system running custom autonomous routines and driver-assist programs.

features.title: CAD-First Workflow
features.description: Every part modeled in Onshape before fabrication — test virtually, build once.

donate.heading: Empower Community Growth by Supporting Us
donate.mission: To advance education in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics among youth and underserved communities — through hands-on experiences, mentorship, workshops, competitions, and community outreach.
donate.vision: A future where every young mind, regardless of background, has the opportunity, resources, and encouragement to explore, create, and lead in a rapidly changing world.
